text: Maria : Okay, let ' s get started ; Thanks, everyone, for joining the weekly planning meeting for the Riverside library renovation ; We have, um, quite a lot on the agenda today, so I ' d like to keep each item to about ten minutes if we can ; First we ' ll go over the budget update, then the construction schedule, then the community feedback from last Tuesday ' s open house, and finally the plan for the temporary reading room ; Does anybody want to add anything before we begin? Daniel : Just one small thing ; I ' d like to mention the parking situation at the end, because the contractor asked about it yesterday ; Maria : Sure, we can add that as the last item ; Priya, do you want to start with the budget? Priya : Yes, thanks ; So, the short version is that we are still within the approved budget, but the margin is getting smaller ; The original contingency was four hundred and fifty thousand dollars ; After the change orders for the roof drainage and the new fire alarm panel, we have about two hundred and ten thousand left ; The roof drainage alone was, uh, eighty - seven thousand, which was more than we expected, because the old pipes were in much worse shape than the survey showed ; Daniel : Was that the cast iron section on the north side? Priya : Exactly, the north side ; The inspector said that it would not pass code, so there really wasn ' t a choice ; The fire alarm panel was around sixty thousand, and the rest came from smaller items, like the extra electrical outlets in the study rooms and the accessible door openers ; Maria : Okay ; And do we expect any other big change orders before the end of the year? Priya : The one I ' m worried about is the elevator ; The manufacturer told us last week that the cab they quoted is discontinued, and the replacement model is about twenty - five thousand more ; I ' ve asked them for a written quote, and I should have it by Friday ; If that comes in as expected, we would still have roughly one hundred and eighty - five thousand in contingency, which I think is okay, but it doesn ' t leave much room for surprises in the basement ; Kevin : I mean, honestly, the basement is where I ' d expect surprises ; Nobody has opened those walls since the nineteen seventies ;

Priya : Right, that ' s my concern too ; So my recommendation is that we hold off on the optional items, like the new signage package and the upgraded furniture for the children ' s area, until the basement demolition is finished and we know what ' s behind the walls ; Maria : That sounds reasonable to me ; Does anyone object to postponing the signage and the furniture decision until after demolition? No? Okay, let ' s record that as a decision ; Priya, can you send a short summary to the board? Priya : Yes, I ' ll send it tomorrow morning ; Maria : Great ; Next item, the construction schedule ; Kevin? Kevin : Sure ; So, the good news is that the roof is done and the building is weather tight, which was the big milestone before winter ; The bad news is that we ' re about three weeks behind on the interior framing ; Part of that is the drainage work we just talked about, and part of it is that the framing crew was pulled to another job for about a week in October ; The contractor says they can recover maybe one or two weeks by adding a Saturday shift, but that would cost extra, around nine thousand dollars for the overtime ; Daniel : And what happens if we don ' t pay for the Saturday shift? Kevin : Then the reopening moves from the first week of June to the end of June, most likely ; The problem is that the summer reading program starts in the middle of June, and the children ' s librarians really want to run it in the new space ; Maria : Hmm ; Nine thousand is not nothing, but the summer program is the most visible thing we do all year ; I ' d lean toward paying for the extra shift, as long as it actually buys us the time ; Kevin, can you get the contractor to commit in writing to a date if we approve it? Kevin : I can ask ; They usually don ' t like to commit to a date, but they might agree to a target with a penalty clause, or at least a weekly progress report ; Maria : Let ' s ask for that ; Okay, community feedback ; Daniel, you ran the open house ; Daniel : Yes ; So we had about one hundred and forty people come through, which was more than we expected ; Overall the reaction was really positive ; People loved the big windows in the reading room and the new entrance

from the park side ; The most common request, by far, was for more quiet study space ; A lot of students said that the old building was always too noisy after school ; The second most common comment was about the hours ; People want the library to stay open later on weekdays, at least until eight or nine in the evening ; Priya : The hours are an operating budget question, not a construction question, just to be clear ; Daniel : Right, I told people that we would pass it on to the board ; We also got several comments about accessibility ; One gentleman who uses a wheelchair pointed out that the ramp at the park entrance is quite steep, and he asked whether there would be a handrail on both sides ; Kevin : There will be handrails on both sides ; The drawings show them, they just aren ' t installed yet ; But I can double check the slope against the plans ; Daniel : That would be great ; And finally, a few parents asked whether the children ' s area could have a separate space for toddlers, with softer flooring, because right now it ' s all one big room ; Maria : That connects to the furniture decision we just postponed ; Let ' s keep a list of these requests so we can look at them together once we know the budget after demolition ; Now, the temporary reading room ; Where are we with that? Priya : The lease for the storefront on Main Street is signed, and it starts on the first of next month ; It ' s small, only about twelve hundred square feet, so we can ' t move the whole collection there ; The plan is to bring the most borrowed books, the new releases, and the computers, and to keep everything else in storage ; Kevin : The movers need a final list of what goes to Main Street and what goes to storage by the end of next week ; Maria : Okay, so that ' s an action item for the branch staff ; I ' ll talk to the branch manager this afternoon ; And the last item, parking ; Daniel? Daniel : Yes ; The contractor wants to use half of the staff parking lot for a material staging area starting next month ; That means staff would have to park on the street or at the community center for about four months ; The community center said that ' s fine during the day, but not on Thursday evenings, because they have events ; Maria : Okay ; Let ' s approve the

staging area, but ask the contractor to keep the accessible parking spaces open at all times ; Alright, I think that ' s everything ; To summarize the decisions : we postpone the signage and furniture until after demolition, we approve the Saturday shift if the contractor commits to a target date, and we approve the staging area with the accessible spaces kept open ; Thanks, everyone ; See you next week ;
